configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Common settings, never configured directly. Each preset gets its own build tree under build/, so switching presets never re-configures on top of another generator's cache.

configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.description: The everyday local preset on macOS and Linux; on Windows it needs an x64 Native Tools prompt, because Ninja does not find cl.exe by itself. Debug and Release share one configure: build dev-debug or dev-release.

configurePresets.name: vs
configurePresets.description: Windows only, from any shell. No generator string on purpose: CMake picks the newest Visual Studio it finds, so this does not rot at the next VS release.

configurePresets.name: strict
configurePresets.displayName: strict (warnings as errors, our code only)
configurePresets.description: OQA_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=ON. Reaches oqa::warnings, which vendor sources never link. On Windows from a plain shell, configure vs with -DOQA_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=ON instead.

configurePresets.name: ci-linux
configurePresets.description: What the Linux CI job configures: dev plus ccache.

configurePresets.name: ci-macos
configurePresets.description: What the macOS CI job configures: dev plus ccache, native architecture only. The universal build belongs to the installers (devplan Phase 7).

configurePresets.name: ci-windows
configurePresets.description: What the Windows CI job configures. No compiler cache: sccache with MSVC needs /Z7, and juce_recommended_config_flags gives /Zi in Debug (go.dot found this first).
